description: Expanded GR rolling statistics and per-well normalization: multi-window rolling mean/std/min/max/slope, GR diff at multiple lags, GR percentile rank within well, GR z-score within well, well-level GR aggregates (mean/std/min/max/skew/kurt) broadcast as columns. Cheap, broad coverage of the GR signal beyond the few rolling features in the baseline.
implementation_notes: Build on the baseline feature pipeline; add the listed features on top of exp_b001's set.
Use GroupKFold(5) by well_id. LightGBM GPU if available.
Slope = rolling linear regression slope of GR vs MD within window. Implement efficiently (e.g., via cumulative sums) to avoid O(N*W) cost.
Add new feature functions to src/features.py without overwriting existing ones.
